lists.name: SURBL
lists.removalNote: We send SURBL's removal request ourselves, by email to whitelist@surbl.org (the channel its removal page offers), from the company mailbox, at most once a week per domain while it stays listed (owner 2026-10-16), with every field its form asks for. SURBL reviews each request by hand and answers that mailbox.

lists.name: Spamhaus DBL
lists.removalNote: Spamhaus removals are requested by the domain owner through its Checker page after a verification; a person files it.

lists.removalNote: URIBL removals go through its admin site with an account and a stated reason; a person files it.
